Creality manufacturer data, generated by scripts/shop_profiles/gen_filaments.py.
Dry 55 C for 12 h.
Manufacturer max speed 300 mm/s.
Max volumetric speed 18 mm3/s matches the manufacturer's rating for this printer.
Sold as 'Hyper PLA RFID Stardust' (UK/FR stores: 'Hyper PLA Starry'). Spec block image (AU/FR): 190-230C, bed 45-60C, 30-300 mm/s, fan 80%, density 1.27, tensile 53.3 MPa, elongation 12.1%, flexural 92.8 MPa; conventional print head, carbon-silicon/PEI plate. US page copy also gives 190-230C nozzle, 45-60C bed, 30-300 mm/s; AU/CA feed copy claims 'up to 600 mm/s' (marketing, not used). Reflective flake filler - Creality does not state abrasiveness (abrasive null). RFID spool. Drying not stated; Creality wiki drying guide (generic PLA/PLA-CF row): Creality dryer 55C 8-12h, blast dryer 50-60C 8h; 'suggest' drying, required above 50% RH.
